en: The image shows a night-time view of a grand baroque fountain in a city square, with a historic building and a bell tower featuring an onion-shaped dome in the background. The fountain is ornately decorated with statues and illuminated by lights, and there are blurred car lights indicating long exposure photography. The architecture and style suggest a Central European city.
